name: bc-canvas-fence
description: Draws a bcc fence in the markdown preview as the Bounded Context Canvas it points at.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: A fence reads a Canvas file inside the workspace and draws it. Nothing in the file is executed, and every value it carries is escaped by the renderer.

virtualWorkspaces.description: A fence resolves a path on disk during a synchronous render, which a virtual filesystem cannot answer.
